content:
Using triangle congruence:

Since \(AD\perp CE\) and \(BE\perp CE\),  
\[
\angle ADC=\angle CEB=90^\circ.
\]
Also \(AC=BC\), and because \(\angle ACB=90^\circ\),
\[
\angle ACD+\angle BCE=90^\circ.
\]
In right triangle \(ACD\),
\[
\angle ACD+\angle CAD=90^\circ,
\]
so
\[
\angle CAD=\angle BCE.
\]
Thus \(\triangle ACD\cong \triangle CBE\) by AAS.

Hence
\[
CD=BE=3,\qquad CE=AD=8.
\]
Since \(D,E\) lie on \(CE\) with \(D\) between \(C\) and \(E\),
\[
DE=CE-CD=8-3=5.
\]

\[
\boxed{5}
\]
